title: Autocomplete / Typeahead
prompt: Design a reusable search suggestion widget for a product search box. Suggestions come from a remote endpoint. A user may type, clear, select, change language or use only the keyboard; requests can finish out of order. Draw the component/data-flow architecture, define state owners and contracts, and explain performance, accessibility and recovery. No UI coding is required.
functionalReqs: Debounce remote lookups while keeping input updates immediate
Support loading, no matches, retry, selection and dismissal
Handle composition input, disabled options and keyboard navigation
nonFunctionalReqs: Mid-range phone, long-tail latency, at most 10 suggestions mounted; target immediate input feedback before network completion.

Use combobox/listbox semantics, labelled input, aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant; Arrow keys move active option, Enter commits, Escape closes. Keep DOM focus in input and announce result count politely.
Ignore obsolete generations even if abort arrived too late; show retry for the current query only and keep typed text.

scale.notes: Mid-range phone, long-tail latency, at most 10 suggestions mounted; target immediate input feedback before network completion.
scale.storage: 10 keystrokes in 1 s; 200 ms quiet-period debounce; illustrative interview assumptions, not measured guarantees.

outOfScope: Backend sharding, ranking algorithms and infrastructure provisioning
Implementing a production UI inside this exercise
deepDives: Debounce the fetch by an illustrative 200 ms; abort the previous lookup and also compare requestGeneration before committing. A late response for ca must never overwrite cam. Input text remains separate from the committed selection.
An older slow request succeeds after a newer fast one
Fetch on each change with request identity for small workloads; debounce saves traffic but delays first suggestions. A headless controlled component supports reuse while a wrapper owns caching.
